ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives four surface-mount component options A, B, C, D. The surface of the component in option D on the right is marked “331”, and the reading given below it is “330UH”. Reasoning: According to the common SMD inductor three-digit marking rule, the first two digits are significant digits, the third digit is the multiplier, and the unit is usually read in microhenries; “331” means 33 × 10^1 μH = 330 μH. Therefore the “330UH” given by option D matches the correct reading of the marking “331”.
